frases: Your patio is going to turn into waves!
And it's not the pavers' fault. It's what's under them.
You laid the pavers straight on the dirt, and called it a day.
Then it rains, and winter comes.
The soft soil shifts, the stones sink, and your patio starts to wave.
Here's the fix, in three layers.
First, four to six inches of compacted crushed stone.
Next, one inch of sand, smooth and flat.
Then lock in the edges, so nothing spreads.
Same pavers. Same patio. Zero waves!
Did you skip the base? Tell Norm in the comments!
